name: 華國媛
objective:
The course introduces nanomaterials and their preparation processes (including chemical method and physical methods). Future development and applications are also discussed. This course will cover the following topics:1. Introduction of nanomaterials and Nano-chemistry; 2. Nanomaterials: structure and analysis; 3. Quantum mechanics; 4. Nanomaterials: self-assembly; 5. Nanomaterials: simulation; 6. Carbon-based nanomaterials; 7. Advanced synthesis and processing 8. Growth and application of semiconductor nanoparticles; 9. SEG & ESG prospective.

本門授課之目的在於介紹奈米材料及其製程 (包括化學法及物理法奈米材料法)，並探討奈米材料的未來發展及應用。所包括的課程主題如下：1. 奈米材料與奈米化學簡介。2. 奈米材料與結構分析 3. 量子力學; 4. 奈米材料自我組成 5. 奈米材料模擬 6. 碳化奈米材料 7 先進奈米材料製成 8. 奈米材料的應用; 9. 奈米材料的遠景與未來發展。
課程進度(1-16週):
Week        Title
1      Introduction on nanomaterials- nanotechnology in the ancient days and nature
2.    Nanomaterials: synthesis and structure
3.    Nanomaterials - nanocrystalline materials, nanocomposites, nanoporous material
4.   Nanomaterials- metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), inorganic-organic hybrid nanocomposites
5.    Properties of nanomaterials
6.    Electrical properties 
7.    Magnetic properties 
8.    Surface properties 
9.    Midterm Exam
10.  Quantum mechanics for beginners
11.  Optical properties
12.  Core-shell nanoparticles and gold nano-shells
13.   Carbon nanoworld - fullerenes, carbon nanotubes and graphene 
14.   Synthesis of nanomaterials at atomic scale
15.   Applications of nanomaterials and nanotechnology
16.    SDG of nanotechnology
17.    Safety Issues, Regulations, and Public Perception
18.    Final exam (Report)
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 線上數位教材學習 (Coursera、edX、磨課師等)(Online digital learning (Coursera, edX, MOOCs, etc.))
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Students will work in groups to discuss safety issues, regulations, and public perception through online collaboration and the application of AI tools.  Regarding open topics such as safety issues, regulations, and public perception of nanotechnology, students should integrate what they have learned in class to provide concrete arguments and response strategies. Deepen personal critical thinking and original analysis.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          10
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          This course encourages the effective use of generative AI as a tool for data organization in Week 17 and return the report as the learning outcomes.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          The outcomes of flexible learning in weeks 17–18 (the final official report and group discussions) account for 30% of the overall course grade (i.e., the final report component in the evaluation criteria).

Policy on Usage of AI:
1. Fact-Checking Professional Knowledge and Data
2. Prohibit Blind Faith in AI Outputs:  Any physicochemical properties of nanomaterials, chemical reaction formulas, structural characterizations, experimental data, or regulatory standards in the report must be based on textbooks or peer-reviewed academic journals.
3. Trace Original Literature: All sources listed in the references must be manually retrieved and verified for authenticity.
